Summary: Mercy is God's compassion toward those who deserve judgment, shown when He spared Israel again and again and supremely when He gave His Son. Jesus embodied mercy, welcoming sinners, healing the broken, and forgiving even those who crucified Him. Because we have received mercy, we are called to be merciful to others.
KeyPassages: Exodus 34:6-7; Psalm 103:8-13; Micah 7:18; Luke 6:36; Ephesians 2:4-5; Titus 3:5
RelatedBooks: Exodus; Psalms; Micah; Luke; Ephesians; Titus
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and Crossing of the Red Sea; Jonah and the Great Fish; The Crucifixion
